entries.desc: Run default init on a temp project and verify Koala management assets exist while `src/core`, `src/shells`, and `tests` starter assets are absent.

evidence.note: Updated smoke now also asserts repo-local init --help documents starter content as optional, and default init still creates only management assets with no starter src/tests.

entries.desc: Run default init where `.Codex/agents` already contains stale prompts and verify Koala still refreshes managed Codex assets without creating starter source files.

evidence.note: Existing stale .Codex/agents prompts are removed while default init still does not create starter source/test directories.

entries.desc: Run init with explicit `--starter` and verify the legacy starter templates are created only in that opt-in mode.

evidence.note: Smoke runs both --starter and --with-template and asserts legacy starter source/test templates are created only when opted in.

entries.desc: Run default init in a temp Python project with `requirements.txt` and no `src`; verify no `src` is created and config has `scanRoot` equal to `.`.

evidence.note: Python no-src smoke creates pyproject.toml before init, asserts no src/tests are created, and asserts language=python with scanRoot=.

entries.desc: Run default init in a project with a pre-existing real `src` directory and verify config can still use `scanRoot: src` without treating Koala-created files as evidence.

evidence.note: New pre-existing src smoke creates src/index.ts before default init, then asserts scanRoot remains src while src/core/app.ts, src/shells/cli/main.ts, and tests are not generated.

entries.desc: Run starter init in an empty temp project and verify the intentionally created starter source tree pairs with `scanRoot: src`.

evidence.note: Starter-mode smoke asserts intentionally created starter source tree pairs with scanRoot=src.

entries.desc: Run `npm run test:entrypoints` after building and see the default-init, starter-init, and Python scanRoot assertions pass.

evidence.note: Full entrypoint smoke passed 11/11 after adding init --help and pre-existing src runtime contract checks.

entries.desc: Inspect the smoke assertions to confirm they check absence of starter directories as well as presence of managed Koala/Codex assets.

evidence.note: Smoke assertions precisely split default init and optional starter help sections, preventing documentation drift from passing silently.

entries.desc: Break one of the init contracts locally in thought or by reading assertions and confirm the smoke would fail on that regression path.

evidence.command: code review of negative assertions plus npm run test:entrypoints
evidence.note: A regression that recreates default starter dirs, removes starter templates, or writes Python scanRoot=src would fail the explicit smoke assertions.
